task_metadata.research_topic: Question-level routing design for hybrid LLM post-training
task_metadata.research_question: How should a fixed off_sft + grpo_split hybrid scaffold route each question among on-policy RL, off-policy RL, and off-policy SFT using current and historical training signals?
notes: V2 widens the editable surface from a single threshold function to trainer-side hybrid routing regions.
The benchmark uses three OpenR1 source-split settings instead of paper-scale 7B/8-GPU evaluation.
LUFFY and SRFT remain read-only references; the visible baselines stay SFT, GRPO, and HPT.

tests.label: olympiads
tests.notes: Hardest OpenR1 source split, hidden in v1.

baselines.name: sft
baselines.notes: Shared-scaffold pure-SFT limit: always replace a question's on-policy samples with one off-policy SFT demonstration.

baselines.name: grpo
baselines.notes: Shared-scaffold pure on-policy controller: never switch into off-policy samples.

baselines.name: hpt
baselines.notes: Original Unify-Post-Training switch logic on the V2 off_sft + grpo_split scaffold.
